Interface LevelResolver

All Known Subinterfaces:
LevelResolver.LevelConfig
public interface LevelResolver
Resolves levels from logger names.
API Note
System.Logger.Level.ALL is considered to be equivalent to null or unspecified.

    • resolveLevel

      System.Logger.Level resolveLevel(String name)
      Determines what level the logger should be at. System.Logger.Level.ALL is to signal that nothing was resolved.
      Parameters:

      resolved level or System.Logger.Level.ALL if unable to resolve.

    • checkEnabled

      static boolean checkEnabled(System.Logger.Level level, System.Logger.Level loggerLevel)
      Statically checks if requested level is greater than or equal to the logger level based on LevelResolver rules.

      Rules are:

      1. OFF for either level or logger level is false
      2. ALL is converted to TRACE for both level and loggerLevel
      Parameters:
      level - if OFF will always return false.
      loggerLevel - if OFF will always return false.
      Returns:
      true if level is greater or equal to loggerLevel unless either is OFF.
      API Note
      this method is mainly used for testing purposes and is not designed with performance in mind. In facades it is better to get an integer and use that for comparison.

    • parseLevel

      static System.Logger.Level parseLevel(String input) throws IllegalArgumentException
      Parses a Level from a string. ALL is converted to TRACE.
      Parameters:
      input - level like String where case is ignored and SLF4J and JUL level names are supported as well.
      Returns:
      level
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the input is not recognized as a level.
